public.title: Where does your donation go?
public.lead: Every year, the management approves and then publishes our figures: donations received, spending and results in the field. Only totals are published, never personal data.
public.published: Figures approved and published by the management.
public.publishedOn: Figures approved and published by the management on {date}.

kpi.revenueHint: {count, plural, one {# confirmed donation} other {# confirmed donations}}, refunds deducted

revenue.title: Donations received
revenue.text: Donations confirmed during the year, net of refunds, converted into euros (the CFA franc has a fixed exchange rate).

expenses.title: How the money is used
expenses.text: Documented expenses recorded by our finance team, by category and by project.
expenses.empty: This year’s expenses have not been recorded yet.
expenses.plannedNote: Planned budget: the project’s total budget, all years combined.

impact.title: Results in the field
impact.scope: Reported totals for projects active during the year: a multi-year project counts in each year it covers.

documents.title: Annual reports
documents.empty: No report has been published for this year yet.

method.title: Our method
method.net: Amounts are net of refunds; a fully refunded donation is not counted.
method.privacy: No personal data is published, only totals. Unpublished projects are grouped together.
method.rate: Donations in CFA francs are converted at the fixed rate of 655.957 XAF to €1.
method.impact: Impact indicators are reported by each project’s team.
method.question: A question about our accounts?

empty.title: Our first accounts are coming soon
empty.text: Figures are published as soon as the management has approved them. Please check back soon!

team.title: Our team and volunteers
team.lead: Behind every action are women and men committed to children and the most vulnerable, in Douala, Yaoundé, Dschang and the villages of the West region.
team.teamText: Presidency, coordination, finance and support units.
team.volunteersText: They give their time for back-to-school drives, orphanage visits, health campaigns and collections.
team.emptyText: Team members freely choose whether to appear on this page.
team.joinTitle: Would you like to join us?
team.joinText: Volunteering, skills, time: every contribution counts.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.text: This page is not available offline yet. Pages you have already visited remain accessible.
offline.backOnline: You are back online: you can try again.
offline.tipCached: Tip: install the HOPE app from your browser menu to open it faster.
offline.tipEco: Data saver mode makes pages lighter on slow connections.

profileForm.selfInfoText: Your portrait only appears on the “Our team and volunteers” page if you agree. You can remove it at any time.
profileForm.consentSelf: I agree that my name, photo and introduction appear on the public website
profileForm.consentSelfHint: Your email and phone number are never published.
profileForm.consentAdmin: Portrait visible on the public website
profileForm.consentAdminHint: Only enable with the written consent of the person concerned.
profileForm.title: Displayed role
profileForm.titleHint: For example: Regional coordinator, Volunteer trainer.
profileForm.photoHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, 5 MB maximum. A square portrait works best.

budget.title: Budget and expenses
budget.description: Planned budget per project, documented expenses and planned vs. actual variances. These figures feed the public Transparency page once the year is published.
budget.scopedText: You only see and record projects in your region; overhead costs are handled by the management.
budget.emptyText: First create a project in Content → Projects.
budget.overviewText: Amounts in euros, all years combined. A positive variance means an overspend.
budget.noLines: No budget line or expense for this project.

expenseForm.receiptHint: PDF or image (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF), 10 MB maximum. Stored privately, never published.

confirm.lineText: The project’s planned budget will be recalculated.
confirm.expenseText: The expense and its receipt will be permanently deleted.

export.title: Report for funders
export.text: CSV for a period: project indicators, net donations received, planned vs. actual by category and expense details. No donor personal data.
export.logged: Every export is recorded in the activity log.

publication.title: Publishing the accounts
publication.description: A year’s figures only appear on the public page once the management has published them.
publication.readOnlyText: Only the management (national-level roles) can publish or withdraw a year. You can upload reports.
publication.yearsText: Check the figures (Finance, Annual report, Budget) before publishing.
publication.noteHint: Optional: shown at the top of the year’s public page.
publication.confirmText: The year’s totals (donations, spending, impact) will be visible to everyone on the website.

documents.sectionText: Annual reports and accounts as PDF. They are only visible once their year is published.
